blocks.text: The module documentation identifies workspace sub-resources included in this split and imports the agents, stores, export helpers, and authentication dependency used by the routes.
blocks.title: Route scope and dependencies

blocks.text: Request models describe import manifests, price refreshes, instruction toggles, facts, panels, progress, and corrections. Calendar OAuth constants and process-local state support the integration routes.
blocks.title: Request models and OAuth setup

blocks.text: The integration endpoints list and disconnect providers, build a Google consent URL, exchange callback codes, and list, create, or delete calendar events while translating disconnected-account errors.
blocks.title: Calendar integration routes

blocks.text: JSON export/import delegates to chat_workspace. File export validates a format, converts chats to artifacts, writes one or more files, and zips multiple outputs.
blocks.title: Workspace export and import

blocks.anchor: def get_workspace_facts(ws_id: str, owner_id: str = Depends(require_auth)):
blocks.text: Facts routes gate workspace access and read or merge updates. Price refresh preserves estimated 3D-print pricing, searches other parts, flags outliers, updates the custom facts bucket, and records section entries.
blocks.title: Facts and price refresh

blocks.text: The device-spec route assembles five custom slices with empty defaults. The instruction toggle updates one nested step, writes the merged custom object, and records the changed section.
blocks.title: Device specification views

blocks.text: Candidate routes list, accept, or reject proposed facts and correction patches, converting missing candidates and invalid accepted patches into HTTP errors.
blocks.title: Fact and correction review

blocks.title: Panels, progress, and PageSpeed

gotchas: Calendar callback derives identity from an in-memory OAuth state map.
JSON export and human-readable file export are separate paths.
Some candidate routes use dependency-only authentication without an owner parameter.
how_it_works: Serves device-spec, corrections, panels, progress, and PageSpeed
purpose: This FastAPI router exposes workspace sub-resources and owner-scoped Google Calendar integration. Routes authenticate or dependency-check access, delegate storage and agent work to EO modules, translate known failures into HTTP errors, and persist selected generated data back into workspace facts.
summary: Provides workspace-scoped facts, exports, device-spec, corrections, panels, progress, audits, and calendar routes.
